Hero_Desc_Inkle:
Inkle, an ink Elemental born when Sherum's cherished inkwell shattered.
Despite her aloof appearance and composed manner of speech, she is unexpectedly full of endearing blunders.
Perhaps because she watched Sherum for so long as ink, she is a dreamy girl who adores stories.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_Inkle: The One Who Gently Seeps In
Album_Wish_Inkle: To leave her mark upon the world
Album_Inkle1: Inkle is an ink Elemental born from an inkwell filled with Sherum's memories. Calm and mature, she uses archaic words and turns of phrase. Yet because she believes ink must ultimately be 'written,' she approaches everything proactively.
Album_Inkle2: No matter what anyone says, Inkle considers Sherum's stories the most entertaining. Perhaps after listening to Sherum's tales for so long, even her thoughts and tastes have grown similar...
Album_Inkle3: Inkle loves learning about anything and everything. She has apparently been learning a great deal about the world from Naia, a high-ranking Elemental... Perhaps a little restraint would be wise.
Album_Inkle4: Anything sounds plausible when Inkle says it. Even meaningless words feel filled with profound significance once she restates them.
Album_Inkle5: Unexpectedly, Inkle seems rather clumsy. She often trips and constantly loses things. What is remarkable is how entirely unbothered she remains, never losing her composure.
Album_Inkle6: Inkle does not seem skilled with her hands either. I hung a picture she gave me in the banquet hall, and Mayo said there was no need for such a thing. Perhaps it was my imagination, but Inkle, who usually sits for a long time drinking warm tea, left unusually early that day.
Album_Inkle7: Inkle says she has made many memories lately that she never wants to forget. She once thought it would be fine to disappear at any moment, but now she wishes to live in harmony with everyone for a long, long time.
LoveHero_Inkle: I am moved that you would take an interest in me. I shall live up to your expectations.
LoveHeroCancel_Inkle: Please seek me out again whenever you wish. I shall always remain by your side.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Hate1: She tried it after Sherum and found it so bitter that she instantly understood what people meant by 'going to the Weekend Farm.' In the end, her eyes even filled with tears of sympathy for Sherum.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Hate2: She said its excessively ornate appearance repelled her, insisting that true beauty lies in the contrast between light and shadow.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like1: She says it is a food steeped in memories that she had wanted to taste ever since her days inside the inkwell. She slowly savored it while recalling the past.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like2: She said warm tea relaxed her and brought inspiration. After muttering excitedly to herself, she declared that she had to write immediately and dashed out of the banquet hall.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like3: The clear white soup fascinated her. Saying that something about its complete contrast with herself drew her in, she studied it for a long time.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like4: She was startled and asked whether I had given her a log, but relaxed upon learning it was cake. She looked pleased with herself for learning not to judge anything solely by its appearance.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like5: She says she favors tart snacks when writing late into the night. Nothing else is as effective at sharpening her focus.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like6: She was moved, saying the dish seemed filled with care. She added that sincerity can only be felt when something bears the warmth of the maker's hands.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like7: She worried it would be too sweet, but became intrigued by how the sweetness and bitterness blended in striking harmony.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like8: When told it was a nutritional supplement, she carefully analyzed the flavor, saying she wanted to make it for someone who was tired every day.
Food_ChefNote_Inkle_Like9: When told the candies represented the seven races of Elias, she was deeply moved by the remarkable story behind them.

LoveLetter_Inkle:
Greetings, Master.

Writing a letter personally still feels unfamiliar and awkward, but I gathered my courage and took up the brush to express my gratitude. I wanted to thank you for always listening to my worries and sharing such pleasant conversations with me.

Ah, lately I have been practicing my handwriting with Sherum. I was told that my writing is rather difficult to read. I would be delighted if even a little of my practice's result reaches you.

Until we meet in person and share more delightful stories.
Inkle.
LoveCall_Inkle:
Master, today I ventured into the city center alone.
After losing my way and wandering for quite some time, darkness finally descended.
And yet, Master, even amid pitch-black darkness, the city shone with brilliant light.
The glow spilling from the buildings held my gaze for a very long time.
It reminded me of you.
You are the one who stands at the center of darkness and shines brightly upon everyone.

Ah, my words seem to be growing increasingly disordered. Forgive me.
For some reason, it is only before you that I reveal such an unguarded side.

I called to arrange our next meeting.
I purchased an intriguing object in the city, but do not understand how to use it.
If you have time to spare, might you grant some of it to me?
My learning remains insufficient, and I wish to receive your guidance.
You may consider it a convenient excuse if you like. That I wish to see you is the undeniable truth.

Ah, it has already grown so late... Then I shall await your reply.
Affinity_Inkle_EP01_001: Master, if you happen to have a towel, lend me one.
Affinity_Inkle_EP01_003: ...Then give me that, at least. I shall wipe the place where I sat before I leave.
Affinity_Inkle_EP01_005: Again?! What do you mean, again? This is my first time! Truly!
Affinity_Inkle_EP01_006: I will give you some hot tea too.
Affinity_Inkle_EP01_007: Thank you. Phew... When one looks at the whole, one can miss what is close at hand. ...Why are you making that face?
Affinity_Inkle_EP02_001: The rising sun is bound to set someday, but the setting sun rises again.
Affinity_Inkle_EP02_002: The sunset is worth seeing too.
Affinity_Inkle_EP02_003: Indeed. The sunset over Spirit Lake is truly beautiful.
Affinity_Inkle_EP02_005: Hmm... Was it that obvious? This is a little embarrassing. Still, hearing you say that, Master, is comforting.
Affinity_Inkle_EP02_006: You make obvious things sound surprisingly convincing.
Affinity_Inkle_EP02_007: ...Master, I think you lack a little sensitivity. Have you become too absorbed in that field called science?
Affinity_Inkle_EP03_001: Sometimes the other person suddenly bursts out laughing for no reason in the middle of a conversation. I never know what to do then...
Affinity_Inkle_EP03_002: You can make people laugh without even studying comedy!
Affinity_Inkle_EP03_003: I-I see? I was not trying to be funny... This is a rather strange feeling.
Affinity_Inkle_EP03_005: Why should I laugh when it is not funny? Hmm... Is it part of being sociable?
Affinity_Inkle_EP03_006: Because you have a good sense of humor.
Affinity_Inkle_EP03_007: Sense...? That is something I would love to tell Sherum!
Affinity_Inkle_EP04_001: Hmm! Your cooking improves by leaps and bounds every day, Master!
Affinity_Inkle_EP04_002: So you mean it used to be bad?
Affinity_Inkle_EP04_003: Ha... haha! Th-that is not what I meant... Well... To be honest, it is...
Affinity_Inkle_EP04_004: All right, I am in the mood! One extra bowl, on the house!
Affinity_Inkle_EP04_005: I will not refuse. It is truly delicious. I am already looking forward to my next visit!
Affinity_Inkle_EP04_007: Mm-hmm. As expected, effort never betrays us. Excellent!
Affinity_Inkle_EP05_001: Sometimes what is lacking can fill the whole.
Affinity_Inkle_EP05_002: Why do you make things sound so complicated?
Affinity_Inkle_EP05_003: C-complicated...? I did not mean to... Hmm. How can I explain it more simply?
Affinity_Inkle_EP05_004: I agree. Since we are at it, we should do a thorough cleaning.
Affinity_Inkle_EP05_005: A good decision. To be honest, the Banquet Hall has felt too cramped every time I enter. It seems we should clear some space while cleaning.
Affinity_Inkle_EP05_006: Did I put on a little too much topping?
Affinity_Inkle_EP05_007: Ahem! ...Next time, please use a more reasonable amount. It is delicious enough without piling on the toppings.
Affinity_Inkle_EP06_001: Do you think I am a boring spirit?
Affinity_Inkle_EP06_003: I see... So I am not boring, but I am not especially interesting either. Hmm... Well, do I really need to stand out?
Affinity_Inkle_EP06_004: You can be unexpectedly funny when you let your guard down.
Affinity_Inkle_EP06_005: I-I see...? I did not intend it, but knowing I have made Master laugh is a happy thought.
Affinity_Inkle_EP06_007: I-I see... That does sting a little. Not merely uninteresting, but dull...
Affinity_Inkle_EP07_001: Master! Could you help me? L-look at this!! Can it be fixed?!
Affinity_Inkle_EP07_002: It is not broken. The power is simply off.
Affinity_Inkle_EP07_003: I-I see? I thought I had broken it. Smartphones are such delicate machines.
Affinity_Inkle_EP07_005: N-no! What was it called... glue! Could we stick it back together with that? It is too shattered? Ugh... This is terrible...
Affinity_Inkle_EP07_006: How did it end up like this?
Affinity_Inkle_EP07_007: Hmm. I found this on Sherum's desk instead of an ink bottle, so I picked it up to see what a typewriter was like, and then this happened... Sherum will be furious if she finds out... Ugh.
Affinity_Inkle_EP08_001: How about some hot tea? Set aside some time to have a cup with me.
Affinity_Inkle_EP08_002: Sounds good. Some fine tea leaves arrived just in time.
Affinity_Inkle_EP08_003: Oh... This is... Sejak tea, is it not? You brought out such precious tea for me... I am touched!
Affinity_Inkle_EP08_005: Ugh, whether it is hot or cool was not the important part. Master, do people often say you cannot read the room?
Affinity_Inkle_EP08_006: Wait a moment. I will bring some snacks.
Affinity_Inkle_EP08_007: Hmm? No need for snacks. Would that not reduce the time I get to spend with Master? Come sit here quickly.
Affinity_Inkle_EP09_001: Do you know how good ink is made? It is made through a long, arduous period of patience.
Affinity_Inkle_EP09_002: Ballpoint pens are better than ink.
Affinity_Inkle_EP09_003: Ugh... You do not understand the value of tradition. Grinding ink is a peaceful time that can be enjoyed, if only briefly.
Affinity_Inkle_EP09_004: Were you not the spirit of ink?
Affinity_Inkle_EP09_005: Does that matter? A spirit of ink can use ink too. If you nitpick every little thing, living in Elias will be exhausting.
Affinity_Inkle_EP09_006: I know. I heard it takes about a year or so?
Affinity_Inkle_EP09_007: Sometimes it takes longer than a year. Ink made after enduring that time is truly excellent. Is life not the same?
Affinity_Inkle_EP10_001: Master, you look as though you need help. Let me give you a hand.
Affinity_Inkle_EP10_002: Thanks a lot. Go call Naia for me.
Affinity_Inkle_EP10_003: Hmm? Naia? Wait a moment. I will be right back. But... I trust you are not sending me away because you are busy.
Affinity_Inkle_EP10_005: It seems you are not that busy after all. Very well, I shall quietly enjoy a cup of tea here. But ask if you need help.
Affinity_Inkle_EP10_006: ...What are you planning to break this time...?
Affinity_Inkle_EP10_007: Break something?! That is harsh! Look, if I am careful, I can... Whoa! M-my hand slipped! I-I am sorry!!
Affinity_Inkle_EP11_001: Farming... is nothing like theory at all.
Affinity_Inkle_EP11_002: Did you blow up the ground?
Affinity_Inkle_EP11_003: Hmm... It does seem different... No, a huge hole suddenly appeared in the middle of the field. It appeared after I passed by, so I do not think it was my fault.
Affinity_Inkle_EP11_005: Scold me? No, I merely received some advice. Theory was still a great help, though.
Affinity_Inkle_EP11_007: Indeed. It is not limited to farming. Everything is like that... Master, you understand these things rather well.
Affinity_Inkle_EP12_001: Master, this place feels a little dry. How about raising the humidity?
Affinity_Inkle_EP12_003: Goodness... I was talking about the proper humidity, and you suddenly insult me. That is not a good habit.
Affinity_Inkle_EP12_004: Is that so? I had not noticed.
Affinity_Inkle_EP12_005: The humidity is only 30% right now. We should raise it to at least around 70%. Hmm? That is too much?
Affinity_Inkle_EP12_006: I will turn on the humidifier for you.
Affinity_Inkle_EP12_007: Thank you. Phew~ I feel a little more comfortable now. I appreciate your thoughtfulness, Master.
Affinity_Inkle_EP13_001: Someone asked me why I cannot paint if I am a spirit of ink.
Affinity_Inkle_EP13_003: Master, you should make a habit of seeing other people's strengths before their flaws.
Affinity_Inkle_EP13_004: What does ink have to do with painting?
Affinity_Inkle_EP13_005: Exactly. Hmm... I hear Elves use a technique called printing to make pictures. Ink seems to be used for it... Perhaps that is why people make the connection.
Affinity_Inkle_EP13_006: Should that not be the paint spirit's specialty?
Affinity_Inkle_EP13_007: Haha. If you were trying to make me laugh, you succeeded. But being the paint spirit does not guarantee that one is good at painting.
Affinity_Inkle_EP14_001: A spirit I do not get along with? I cannot think of one in particular... but Ifrit is a little difficult to approach.
Affinity_Inkle_EP14_002: Did you have a fight with Ifrit?
Affinity_Inkle_EP14_003: A fight? Why would I fight Ifrit? She is a spirit of fire, so getting close to her is simply too drying.
Affinity_Inkle_EP14_005: Dislike her? That is a misunderstanding. Ifrit is fire, so her heat makes her hard to approach. I do not dislike Ifrit herself.
Affinity_Inkle_EP14_007: Hmm~ Exactly. Her intense heat makes me feel completely dried out. As a spirit of ink, I become rather gloomy when I am dry.
Affinity_Inkle_EP15_001: Everything is born from nothing and will return to nothing...
Affinity_Inkle_EP15_002: Stop talking and finish clearing the plates.
Affinity_Inkle_EP15_003: Ugh... All right. Still, I would appreciate it if you understood that I did not break the plate on purpose.
Affinity_Inkle_EP15_004: Was the portion a little small? Shall I give you another bowl?
Affinity_Inkle_EP15_005: How does that sound philosophical to you...? Still, give me one more bowl.
Affinity_Inkle_EP15_006: You are talking about the origin of all things.
Affinity_Inkle_EP15_007: You know this story too, Master? It is about the cycle of life. All life exists within a cycle... Master? Are you asleep?
Affinity_Inkle_EP16_003: Why? Being selective about knowledge is not a good habit. Do not be prejudiced; take in knowledge freely.
Affinity_Inkle_EP16_005: First... stories about Master's homeland are fascinating too. And Elven science. It is truly like magic.
Affinity_Inkle_EP16_007: That is true. Perhaps because I spent so long beside spirits and Sherum, witches feel familiar to me. That is why the Elves' patterns of behavior and way of life are so fascinating.
Affinity_Inkle_EP17_001: Sometimes I think witches are more comfortable to be around than spirits.
Affinity_Inkle_EP17_002: You mean Sherum is the one who makes you comfortable?
Affinity_Inkle_EP17_003: Now that I think about it, you are right. But it is not only Sherum; Barie is comfortable too. Hmm... I suppose it is because I have spent so much time with them.
Affinity_Inkle_EP17_005: Do not slander me, Master. Why would I discriminate against spirits? It is simply because I have spent so long with Sherum.
Affinity_Inkle_EP17_006: Really? What makes you say that?
Affinity_Inkle_EP17_007: Places with many books, perhaps... Or leaving various things behind in writing... Those things feel familiar and comforting to me.
Affinity_Inkle_EP18_001: Is there a way to meditate more deeply?
Affinity_Inkle_EP18_003: That would be a poor choice. It might actually interfere with meditation... I feel as though I can hear Asana's endless nagging.
Affinity_Inkle_EP18_004: How about a cup of tea?
Affinity_Inkle_EP18_005: Should I? It seems some good tea leaves have arrived. Then I shall have a cup, please.
Affinity_Inkle_EP18_007: Did it seem that way? No, nothing is wrong. I simply wanted to explore meditation, which I practice as a hobby, a little more deeply... That is all.
Affinity_Inkle_EP19_001: Oh no, if Arco comes looking for me, tell her I am not here.
Affinity_Inkle_EP19_003: Eek! Did you have to startle me like that?! Do not tease a spirit. You took ten years off my life.
Affinity_Inkle_EP19_005: Well... Arco says she can even do traditional dances and insists on teaching me because they would suit me perfectly... But I cannot dance.
Affinity_Inkle_EP19_006: Do not worry, she already came and went.
Affinity_Inkle_EP19_007: I-I see. Phew... Every time Arco sees me, she rushes over saying she will teach me to dance. It is exhausting.
Affinity_Inkle_EP20_001: I spent my life in a very small world... But after coming outside, I found the world so vast and strange.
Affinity_Inkle_EP20_002: I am curious about the small world you used to live in too.
Affinity_Inkle_EP20_003: My small world...? Shall I tell you about the time I lived inside an ink bottle?
Affinity_Inkle_EP20_005: Hmm. That is certainly true. But is that really the right thing to say here? Did I do something wrong to you, Master?
Affinity_Inkle_EP20_006: Let us see another world together too.
Affinity_Inkle_EP20_007: I would like that. I look forward to seeing the world beyond Elias. A journey with Master makes me look forward to it even more.
